postman.com.company_overview: Postman is an API platform that simplifies every step of the API lifecycle, enabling developers to build, test, and manage APIs efficiently and collaboratively.
postman.com.target_audience: Developers, teams, and enterprises building, testing, and managing APIs at scale.

supabase.com.company_overview: Supabase is a fully managed Postgres development platform that provides authentication, real‑time data, storage, and serverless edge functions. Built by developers for developers, it offers a complete backend stack with auto‑generated APIs and enterprise‑grade security.
supabase.com.target_audience: Developers, startups, agencies, enterprises, and innovation teams building applications on Postgres.

vapi.ai.company_overview: Vapi is a voice AI platform that enables developers to build, deploy, and improve voice agents quickly. It offers a unified, enterprise‑ready platform with real‑time monitoring, scalability, and compliance features such as SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI.
vapi.ai.target_audience: Enterprise customers across industries such as healthcare, automotive marketplaces, staffing, and other call‑heavy businesses.
